snippet.title: CortexGear - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
No commentary. 
This is CortexGear.

A raw look at its combat, pacing, and consequences.
Every mistake is real. Every success is earned.

If it looks hard, it’s because it is.
You can also face your friends in PvP using custom servers or LAN.
No excuses. Just skill.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/375620/CortexGear_AngryDroids/

Demo available
—

Solo-developed. Built around execution, not luck.
